title: Consider un-unifying loop_cut: separate coons_loop_cut node
description: Design question raised during DSL-42: loop_cut currently dispatches silently to CoonsLoopCutNode when input carries bezier handles, otherwise does midpoint cuts. That silent behavior-depending-on-attached-data pattern is what prompted the separate coons_inset_faces node (DSL-42) rather than overloading inset_faces. For consistency, re-register coons_loop_cut as its own public node id and have loop_cut be topology-only (midpoint). Agent picks explicitly. Breaking change for any DSL using loop_cut post-handles today — update the coons_cage technique prompt accordingly.
definition-of-done: 1. coons_loop_cut re-registered with @MeshNodeAnnotation. 2. loop_cut reverts to topology-only midpoint cuts; strips (or passes through unchanged) handle slots. 3. Coons cage technique prompt updated to call coons_loop_cut after handles. 4. MeshNodePortDocumentationTest green (socket docs on the re-registered node).
testing-plan: 1. DSL with loop_cut-after-handles falls through to midpoint (verify). 2. DSL with coons_loop_cut-after-handles does de Casteljau (verify). 3. Existing tests still pass.
